verdict.rationale: Navan's own docs describe in-platform booking against its global travel inventory, with self-serve changes and booking, changing or canceling trips via Navan Edge. Policy is applied at booking time for hotels: every hotel search shows a "price to beat" under the employee's policy limit, and the platform offers unlimited policy and approval workflows. The core of the story is delivered, but flight-specific evidence is thin. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-platform flight booking with policy enforcement at the point of booking (e.g., out-of-policy flight blocking or approval routing), and independent or hands-on corroboration of booking-time policy enforcement.
